1934, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 204 July Carolyne Johnston - 48 - Episcopelian - totally blind - Quite earnest - has travel a great - Father prominent physician.
Julia Therese Tarinkel - 11 - doctors baggeled - spinal maningitis ??? Unconscious mostly since July 4 - especially last 10 days. Enrolled twice (50c) To-night is enrolled perpetu'l - % parents.
21st Mrs. Amelia Selesky - 46 - Enrolled at 10P.M. - tumor & periten- itis - operation - just having 6th blood transfusion. We'll hope.
Ernest J. Lents - 33 - comes to thank God for prayers .... on July 4, 1933 bumpt arm from which he took streptococtic infection - worst blood poison ... in bed six months ... went back to work May 16, '34 Was given up as "absolutely hopeless" Now quite normal (See Dr. Lenhard)
Mrs. Anna Currie - wants to sell place of business -1269 Abbott.
22 Paul Grunke - 45 - spinal arthritis in Ford Hospital for week - sent home as hopeless. Now home more than two years with wife & 7 children - in bed almost continually and in terrible pains .. Enrolled at 8:30 p.m. $5.
23 Evelyn Mary Yapp - 45 - Episcopelian - five days income ... quite Hopeless - Enrolled in Ser. Mass A. by phone last Saturday ... im- proving ever since ... Mr. Yapp enrolls her To-night perpetually.
Page 205 July 24 Josephine Ann Menorch - Lutherine - 3 yrs - enrolled by phone for hopeless asthma etc. Comes with parents same evening - Thursday same night.
Henry Kline - 32 - 8 yrs lost .... prayed for June 12 - found just before + July 6 - Happy death .. Deo Gratias.
Mary Kiemam - 73 - losing house .... has niece fears 3 rd stroke. Mrs. M. Stralow - 52 - lost breast - arm swelling very alarmingly Young away from sacraments
Page 206 July 24 Sophie Haener - 43 - fears injury of spine - fell in bath-tub breaking ribs ... had worked all day .... slipped.
Eleanor .Abbosta - 14 - Epileptic now 12 yrs. - mother becoming nervous .
